{{Quote|Isn't that what you say, Syn? Best way to shoot 'em is in the back. Ain't that right?|[[Cade Skywalker]] to Jariah Syn|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 5">[[Legacy (2006) 5|''Legacy'' (2006) 5]]</ref>}}
The '''sporting blaster carbine'''<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" /> was a similar to a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]]. This weapon could be wielded in one [[Limb/Legends|hand]] for medium range, but wielding the weapon with two hands enabled the wielder to fire at long range.

A [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]] carbine required a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] to operate; after 100 shots, the power pack needed to be replaced. This weapon had a close-range [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting as well, meaning the wielder could switch the weapon to fire stun shots instead of lethal fire, however the close-range stun setting was limited to a range of only 9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The sporting [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] cost 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase, but its use was regulated by local authorities.

[[File:JariahCadeDeliah-SWL02.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jariah Syn, on left, who owned a sporting blaster carbine]]
[[Jariah Syn]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] used a [[Jariah Syn's blaster|sporting blaster carbine]] on occasion. It was referred to as a "cannon" by [[Deliah Blue]], likely due to its large size.
